fixed.review_text:
No vulnerabilities found in `parser.go`.

The length check before `url[:nPath]` (lines 792–794) closes the slice-bounds panic described in the comment (GHSA-cv23-7vc5-jfh7), and `url[nPath]` is only read when `nLink > nPath`. The URI loop is similarly guarded by `nLink > nPrefix` before `url[:nPrefix]` and `url[nPrefix]`. Unmatched input falls through to `return false`, so the check fails closed.

vuln.review_text:
The function panics on short input, and its allowlist boundary check is fail-open.

**1. Denial of service (unchecked slice / uncaught panic), CWE-129 / CWE-248**  
File: `parser.go`, line 789  
Quote: `linkPrefix := url[:nPath]`  
`url[:nPath]` runs before the `nLink >= nPath` test on line 790. If any `Paths` entry is longer than `url` (including a short or empty URL), Go panics with a slice bounds error. In a request handler that is a crash/DoS. The URI loop below checks length first; this loop does not.

**2. Allowlist bypass (permissive prefix match), CWE-20 / CWE-183**  
File: `parser.go`, line 793  
Quote: `} else if IsAlnum(url[nPath]) {`  
A matching prefix is treated as safe when the next byte is alphanumeric. That is not a URL token boundary, so a listed prefix also accepts a different host or path that merely continues with `[A-Za-z0-9]` (for example an entry `https://good.com` also matches `https://good.comattacker.com`, and `/admin` also matches `/adminpanel`). The same pattern is on line 805: `if bytes.Equal(linkPrefix, prefix) && IsAlnum(url[nPrefix]) {`. An empty `Paths` or `URIs` entry makes this worse: the empty prefix compares equal, and any URL whose first byte is alphanumeric (including `javascript:`) is accepted.

**3. Incomplete Unicode/case handling (parser differential), CWE-176**  
File: `parser.go`, line 804  
Quote: `linkPrefix := bytes.ToLower(url[:nPrefix])`  
Case-folding is ASCII-only (`bytes.ToLower`), and the comment on line 800 notes Unicode is unhandled. A later parser that normalizes Unicode, strips control characters, or treats `\` as `/` can interpret a URL this function already marked safe as a different scheme or host.
